newsitem.title: UK: Tesco declines comment on mortgage report.
newsitem.headline: Tesco declines comment on mortgage report.

text.p: British supermarket group Tesco Plc declined to comment on Monday on a report in the Financial Times newspaper that it would be offering mortgages to customers through its joint venture with Royal Bank of Scotland.
"We can't comment at the moment," a spokeswoman for the company said.
The Financial Times said the joint venture, Tesco Personal Finance, planned to offer a full range of financial products including mortgages.
The venture, which was agreed in February, is expected to launch a credit card in July along with other services including savings accounts and personal insurance.
The Financial Times added that Tesco supermarkets would have terminals installed where customers could check their credit ratings before applying for loans or mortgages.
Tesco's rival J. Sainsbury Plc said in April that its Sainsbury's Bank venture with Bank of Scotland intended to launch mortgages and personal loans in addition to credit cards and savings accounts.
